question: Who among the following developed the Polio vaccine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jonas Salk**__.

__
 
• **Jonas Salk **developed the **Polio vaccine.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Polio** is a disease caused by three variants of the **poliovirus**.
 
• The virus, which only infects** humans**, can damage the **neurons** that **control movement,** resulting in partial or complete **paralysis.**
 
• In the early **1950**s, two prominent medical researchers each found a way to protect the world from poliomyelitis, the **paralysis-causing disease **commonly known as** polio.**
 
• The vaccines created by** Dr. Jonas Salk** and** Dr. Albert Sabin **resulted in the near-global eradication of polio. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jonas Salk:**__

 __
 
• **Jonas Salk** was born in **New York City, United States (US), to an Orthodox Polish-Jewish immigrant family on 28 October 1914. **
 
• In **1947, Salk** was** appointed director of the Virus Research Laboratory at the University of Pittsburgh School of Medicine.**
 
• Th**e Salk vaccine** was quickly **adopted nationwide, and by 1959, had reached about 90 countries.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 **Person Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 **FG Hopkins**
 
 
 
• FG Hopkins was an English biochemist.
 
• FG Hopkins was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 1929, with Christiaan Eijkman, for the discovery of vitamins, even though Casimir Funk, a Polish biochemist, is widely credited with discovering vitamins.
 
 
 
 

 **Edward Jenner**
 
 
 
• Edward Jenner was a British physician and scientist who pioneered the concept of vaccines including creating the smallpox vaccine, the world's first-ever vaccine.
 
• The terms vaccine and vaccination are derived from Variolae vaccine, the term devised by Jenner to denote cowpox.
 
 
 
 

 **Robert Koch**
 
 
 
• Robert Koch was a German physician and microbiologist.
 
• As the discoverer of the specific causative agents of deadly infectious diseases including tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax, he is regarded as one of the main founders of modern bacteriology.
 
• He has been honored with the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 1905.
